description: OpenRestream gives a person's stream its own slot on their OpenVibe Live channel, ingested by OpenRestream (ingest_authority openre), so its sessions show live on openvibe.live/@username through Live's mirror. Idempotent per OpenRestream stream: a second call returns the same slot. The person must have an OpenVibe Live account (they signed in to Live once); otherwise 409 live.no_account.
